source_snapshot.procedure: Log in to BMC Web UI, but the copied step says check PCIe card information and fields Name, Status and Number.
source_snapshot.criteria: All displayed information should be correct.
source_snapshot.script: Private `nvme-check.git` repository. Five minutes attended and five machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES with insecure generic IPMI sensor output and CPU inlet-temperature expectations copied from the duplicate row; it exposes none of the WebUI storage/PCIe fields.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; asks the owner to choose HDD versus PCIe scope and define Number, then correlate a supported read-only BMC path with OS/controller inventory.

old_problem: The title and NVMe-check script indicate storage/HDD inventory, the Procedure explicitly names PCIe card information, and the common displayed field `Number` has no universal semantic. The prior record required an engineering choice and left Pending. DeepSeek is wholly contaminated by Functionality row 770 / variant e3043fe4369b9230 CPU inlet-temperature coverage. Selecting only HDD or only PCIe would discard source coverage, while equating NVMe PCIe functions with all HDD would be technically false.
disposition_reason: No branch selection is necessary. Preserve both source nouns as independently accepted WebUI subtests: A verifies the BMC's managed HDD/storage inventory, with the Project explicitly declaring SATA/SAS/NVMe/controller scope; B verifies the BMC PCIe-card inventory. In each table a human captures the rendered Name, Status and literal Number label/value for every row. A versioned vendor UI schema defines Number and Status separately per table; the review never guesses count, bay, slot, index, serial or namespace. Read-only Redfish/vendor APIs and same-host OS/controller evidence corroborate every device using stable serial/model/bay/BDF mappings, but cannot replace actual WebUI. Missing topology or field semantics yields NOT READY. Both branches must pass or have separate authoritative applicability evidence, so original coverage is not reduced.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1492, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, private script identity, duplicate row-770 record relationship and locked queue were read directly. The next formal queue identity was independently verified as row 1543 / variant 57eacc37c523883a.

The HDD title and NVMe script provide storage evidence, while the Procedure's explicit PCIe-card wording cannot be erased. A two-branch union is the only interpretation that retains both without inventing equivalence.

NVMe commonly uses PCIe transport, but a PCIe-device list may include NICs, GPUs and accelerators, and HDD/storage scope may include SATA or SAS behind a controller. Therefore a PCIe row cannot automatically prove storage inventory and one NVMe record cannot represent every HDD.

The exact UI label `Number` is testable even before its semantics are bound: capture it verbatim and require the product's BMC UI schema to state whether it means total count, ordinal, bay/slot, controller port, function, namespace or another value. Storage and PCIe tables may use the same word differently.

Likewise, Status must be compared using the exact BMC firmware vocabulary and state/health mapping. `OK`, `Present`, `Enabled`, predictive failure, degraded array and absent slot are not universally interchangeable.

DMTF Redfish defines separate Drive/Storage and PCIeDevice/PCIeFunction resources with identity, status and topology properties. These supply standard corroborating models but do not define an OEM WebUI's `Number` label or prove that a displayed page is fresh and correct.

Storage correlation keys include serial/WWN/EUI/NGUID, model, capacity, protocol, controller and physical bay/slot; PCIe correlation uses domain:bus:device.function, vendor/device/subsystem IDs, serial/part number and physical slot. Ambiguous or many-to-one mapping cannot pass.

Actual rendered WebUI is the core function. A human verifies authenticated navigation, full row visibility, labels, values, pagination/filter state and fresh target context; API, ipmitool sensors, OS inventory or screenshot analysis only supplement it.

All supporting commands remain read-only. No format, mount/unmount, SMART self-test, sanitize, controller reset, RAID action, driver unbind, firmware update, hot-plug or device power action is allowed. Preserve logs instead of clearing them.

ED-02/ED-21 preserve duplicate row identity; ED-03/ED-04/ED-22 make topology and UI schema Project inputs; ED-12/ED-20/ED-23 require genuine WebUI evidence; ED-15 requires authoritative per-branch N/A; ED-17/ED-19 prevent API/sensor substitution; ED-26 prohibits retry; ED-33/ED-35 preserve both source branches; ED-36/ED-38 separate readiness and verdict.

test_case.test_name: BMC WebUI storage and PCIe Name/Status/Number full-source verification
test_case.purpose: Independently verify the exact target BMC WebUI's managed HDD/storage table and PCIe-card table, including every rendered Name, Status and literal Number value, against separate owner-approved schemas and physical/logical topology while using APIs and OS/controller inventory only as read-only corroboration.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/board/chassis, BMC firmware/WebUI build and host identities; fresh secure WebUI path/role, trusted certificate, protected credentials and evidence/redaction policy
Storage branch scope declaring SATA, SAS, NVMe, virtual/RAID members and absent bays; exact controller/backplane/bay/slot/serial/model/capacity/protocol/namespace topology and expected health/state
PCIe branch topology declaring every expected card/function with physical slot, domain:bus:device.function, vendor/device/subsystem IDs, serial/part/model and expected state
Versioned BMC WebUI documentation defining page/table path, pagination/filter behavior and exact Name/Status/Number semantics separately for storage and PCIe; per-branch applicability authority

Supported read-only Redfish/vendor resources and same-host evidence tools such as `lsblk --json`, `nvme list -o json`, approved non-invasive SMART/controller inventory and `lspci -Dnn`; stable cross-interface mapping
Human WebUI operator, fresh-session/cache validation and protected raw/screenshot/normalized evidence store
test_case.test_command: MANUAL WEBUI PROCEDURE WITH READ-ONLY CORROBORATION; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant and exact BMC-host relationship; preserve logs and collect the approved storage and PCIe topology oracles. Open a fresh authenticated BMC WebUI session with trusted TLS and prove page freshness/target identity. Branch A: navigate to the documented HDD/storage inventory, reset only non-mutating display filters, traverse every page, and capture full-context plus row-level evidence for every visible Name, Status and literal Number label/value; record the vendor-defined semantics and map each row to controller/bay/serial/model/protocol/capacity/namespace. Branch B: separately navigate to PCIe-card inventory, traverse every page and capture every Name, Status and Number label/value; map each row to physical slot, full BDF, IDs and serial/part identity. Do not reuse one branch as the other. Through validated read-only interfaces, collect the platform-supported Redfish/vendor storage/drive and PCIe resources plus same-host `lsblk`/`nvme`/controller inventory and `lspci -Dnn`; issue no write-capable option. Compare each UI row, count/Number meaning and status with its branch oracle and corroborating target. Capture missing/extra/duplicate/stale/hidden/filter discrepancies, verify no storage/PCIe state changed, close the session and preserve logs without clearing them.
test_case.expected_result: For each applicable branch, the fresh rendered WebUI shows every expected and no unexplained extra storage device or PCIe card; each row's Name, Status and literal Number value exactly matches that table's approved schema and topology. Storage rows correlate unambiguously to the intended drives/controllers/bays/namespaces and PCIe rows to intended cards/functions/slots/BDFs. Supported read-only API/OS/controller evidence agrees, filters/pagination hide nothing, no stale/cross-host data appears and no device, data, controller, driver, firmware or log state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant/target, both applicable independent WebUI branches, genuine fresh full-table visual evidence, versioned per-table Name/Status/Number semantics, complete storage and PCIe topology, unambiguous per-row mapping, correct expected counts/values/states, read-only API/OS/controller corroboration and no mutation. FAIL covers wrong/missing/extra/duplicate/stale/hidden rows, incorrect label/value/status, topology disagreement, ambiguous identity, media/controller/PCIe health error or unintended change. NOT READY covers missing UI schema, Number/Status definition, topology, secure WebUI/operator or read-only mapping tools. A branch is N/A only with authoritative product applicability evidence. CPU sensors, IPMI SDR, one branch or API-only evidence cannot pass the other or the WebUI function.
safety_gate: All access is read-only. Never format, erase, sanitize, mount/unmount, write-test, start SMART self-test, reset a drive/controller/function, rebuild RAID, unbind a driver, update firmware, hot-plug or change power/locate state.

A human owns actual WebUI login/navigation and visual row acceptance. Validate target identity, page freshness, filters and pagination; API or screenshot analysis cannot replace the rendered function.
Protect BMC/OS credentials and storage identifiers while retaining enough serial/bay/BDF context for audit. Do not disable TLS/host verification or use plaintext passwords in command lines.
Preserve SEL, storage/controller, PCIe and OS logs; do not clear evidence. Separate pre-existing events from access-time observations.

Stop on device disappearance, degraded array/media error, controller/PCIe fault, ambiguous mapping, write-capable command requirement or unexpected UI action. Preserve the first state and do not automatically retry or refresh toward a desired result.
Do not infer `Number` or Status semantics from visual position/string similarity. Require the exact BMC firmware UI schema for each branch and report unsupported fields explicitly.
The review agent executes no WebUI, storage, PCIe, IPMI or DUT action and issues no hardware PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; SUT/BMC/board/chassis/BMC-WebUI/host identities; session/role/timestamp and duplicate CPU-sensor row exclusion
Versioned per-branch UI paths, filters/pagination, Name/Status/Number definitions and authoritative applicability decisions
Complete storage controller/backplane/bay/slot/serial/model/capacity/protocol/namespace oracle and PCIe slot/full-BDF/ID/serial/part oracle
Fresh full-context and every-page/row WebUI captures for storage and PCIe kept independently identifiable
Raw and normalized read-only Redfish/vendor plus `lsblk`/`nvme`/approved controller/SMART and `lspci` evidence with per-row correlation/diff
Preserved logs, no-mutation audit, discrepancy list, Tool Result/engineer verdict separation and explicit no-DUT-action-by-review-agent statement
test_case.recovery: Because the intended workflow is read-only, normal recovery is to stop, preserve the fresh UI/API/OS state, close sessions and verify storage/PCIe inventory and health are unchanged. If a device vanishes, a controller/array degrades, media/PCIe errors appear or any unintended action occurs, perform no refresh loop, reset, rebuild, remount, hot-plug or power cycle; use only the pre-existing platform incident/recovery runbook under the storage/PCIe owner and protect data. Resolve schema or mapping ambiguity offline before a newly authorized observation.

source_conflict.reason: The HDD title/script and explicit PCIe procedure are retained as two independent WebUI subtests, and Number is bound literally through a per-table vendor schema. No word is discarded or equated, so a branch-choice decision is no longer needed.

blocked.reason: Both safe read-only workflows, evidence and recovery are defined. Exact UI schemas, Number/Status meanings, scopes and topologies are bounded Project inputs; their absence is NOT READY rather than an irreducible engineering conflict.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact BMC/host and WebUI build; separate storage and PCIe page schemas; literal Name/Status/Number semantics; storage controller/backplane/bay/serial/namespace and PCIe slot/BDF/ID topology; scope/applicability; secure operator/session and supported read-only cross-interface mappings.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER MANUAL WEBUI/READ-ONLY CORRELATION DEFINITION ONLY; NO LOGIN, WEBUI, STORAGE, PCIE, IPMI, OS, LOG, DUT OR OTHER HARDWARE ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268 2026.1
external_authorities.application: Defines separate Drive/Storage and PCIeDevice/PCIeFunction resource models used as read-only corroboration; OEM WebUI labels, Number semantics and target topology remain project-specific.

project_authority: The BMC/storage/PCIe owners define the two page scopes, per-table labels/status/Number semantics, expected device topologies and applicability; a human owns WebUI visual evidence and the engineer verdict. They cannot collapse branches, equate NVMe with all HDD/PCIe, substitute CPU sensors or API-only evidence, guess Number, waive ambiguous mapping, authorize writes or clear logs.
